{
  "summary": "Review of the glucosepane chemistry, source mapping, protonation/charge state, and matched-control preparation confirms that the 56-atom split-residue topology (AGS: 38 atoms, LGX: 18 atoms; AGS:NZ-LGX:CE bond = 0.147 nm) and OpenMM force/energy equivalence against the GROMACS Amber99SB*-ILDNP parser are numerically verified. However, five concrete chemical and methodological issues must be resolved before longer production or mechanical MD: (1) replacing the neutral glucosepane crosslink with juxtaposed ARG(+1) and LYS(+1) side chains on two untethered 15-mer single strands introduces strong local +1/+1 Coulombic repulsion and free strand dissociation in GLU_CONTROL; (2) the source ColBuilder RTP models glucosepane as a deprotonated neutral ring (joint charge -1e-6 e) rather than the physiological protonated (+1 e) cyclic guanidinium state; (3) solute side chains are energy-minimized in vacuum (NoCutoff) prior to solvation; (4) the 80-atom motif mapping and runtime tetrahedral checks validate only 2D graph isomorphism and relative volume-sign retention, not absolute (R/S) stereochemistry at the three glucosepane ring stereocenters; and (5) GLU_CONTROL mixes one double-precision replica (10.211 A) with two mixed-precision replicas (12.525 A, 11.919 A).",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Unlinked control (GLU_CONTROL) introduces direct ARG(+1)/LYS(+1) interface repulsion between two untethered single strands",
      "source_file": "candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md",
      "source_line": 20,
      "evidence": "GLU_LINKED connects two excised 15-residue single chains (chain 23 resid 101 and chain 19 resid 1046) via a neutral AGS-LGX bridge (solute charge -1 e), whereas GLU_CONTROL restores positively charged ARG(+1) and LYS(+1) side chains at the former 1.458 A crosslink site (solute charge +1 e, 471 vs 481 solute atoms) with all positional restraints set to k = 0 during the 30-ps production window.",
      "implication": "Beyond the acknowledged global counterion swap (11 Na/12 Cl vs 12 Na/11 Cl), placing +1 ARG and +1 LYS face-to-face at a 1.46 A starting contact between two isolated single strands lacking triple-helical partner chains or terminal boundary restraints actively drives electrostatic strand separation, confounding covalent link removal with local Coulombic repulsion and free two-chain diffusion.",
      "recommended_check": "Include a charge-matched unlinked control (neutral LYN and deprotonated ARG or capped neutral half-link residues) alongside a protonated (+1 e) glucosepane model, and apply weak terminal C-alpha positional restraints on the two excised 15-mer ends to represent the omitted triple-helical/fibril scaffold.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    },
    {
      "severity": "high",
      "title": "Source neutral glucosepane parameterization omits the physiological protonated (+1 e) cyclic guanidinium state and leaves a -1e-6 e charge residual",
      "source_file": "candidate/PARAMETER_AUDIT.json",
      "source_line": 42,
      "evidence": "AGS (38 atoms, charge +0.065840 e, containing N*, N2, N3 atom types) and LGX (18 atoms, charge -0.065841 e) sum to a neutral joint_charge_e of -1.000000000139778e-06 e rather than +1.0 e.",
      "implication": "Glucosepane contains a bicyclic 6-amino-7,8-dihydro-5H-imidazo[4,5-b]azepine (cyclic guanidinium) core that is protonated (+1 e) at physiological pH 7.4; modeling the deprotonated neutral free base alters local hydration, salt-bridge interactions, and ring torsional electrostatics, while the -1e-6 e partial-charge rounding mismatch leaves a tiny non-zero net system charge (-1e-6 e) under PME.",
      "recommended_check": "Benchmark the neutral ColBuilder AGS/LGX charges against a protonated (+1 e) glucosepane RESP parameterization at pH 7.4, and adjust the AGS/LGX boundary charge by +1e-6 e so the joint residue charge is an exact integer.",
      "claim_status": "assumption"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "Vacuum (NoCutoff) side-chain minimization precedes solvation and box construction",
      "source_file": "candidate/candidate_pilot.py",
      "source_line": 73,
      "evidence": "In prepare(), GLU_CONTROL and GLU_LINKED construct a gas-phase NoCutoff System, restrain only backbone N, CA, C, O atoms (k = 1000 kJ/mol/nm^2), minimize all side chains for up to 2000 steps in vacuum, and pass the vacuum-relaxed coordinates directly to solvate().",
      "implication": "Unrestrained side-chain minimization in vacuum (dielectric = 1) exposes the restored ARG(+1)/LYS(+1) side chains in GLU_CONTROL and the polar hydroxyl/ring nitrogens of AGS/LGX in GLU_LINKED to unscreened gas-phase Coulomb forces, promoting artificial intramolecular salt bridges or side-chain repulsion that alters principal-axis box sizing and initial solvation.",
      "recommended_check": "Restrain all heavy solute atoms during dry clash relief (relaxing only added hydrogens) or perform side-chain minimization exclusively after explicit TIP3P water and NaCl ions are added.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "title": "2D graph-isomorphism mapping and relative determinant signs do not verify absolute (R/S) stereochemistry of the three glucosepane ring stereocenters",
      "source_file": "candidate/prepared/published_glucosepane_motif/ATOM_MAPPING.json",
      "source_line": 2,
      "evidence": "The 80-atom reference motif mapping is verified solely by 2D graph invariants (element, degree, charge, all edges and nonedges), and runtime stereocenter monitoring (28 centers in GLU_CONTROL vs 31 in GLU_LINKED) tests only whether determinant signs invert relative to the initial coordinate array.",
      "implication": "Graph isomorphism is invariant to 3D tetrahedral inversion and prochiral CH2 hydrogen swaps. If the upstream ColBuilder fibril coordinates for resid 101/1046 started with a diastereomeric flip at any of the three extra glucosepane ring chiral centers (C6, C7, C8) or swapped geminal atoms in an improper torsion, the relative sign check (inversions == 0) will pass while simulating the wrong diastereomer.",
      "recommended_check": "Compute explicit Cahn-Ingold-Prelog (R/S) configurations for the three AGS ring stereocenters in the starting coordinates and verify against canonical D-glucose-derived glucosepane stereochemistry.",
      "claim_status": "implementation_fact"
    },
    {
      "severity": "low",
      "title": "Integration precision asymmetry in GLU_CONTROL and duplicate harmonic X-H bonds on constrained solute pairs",
      "source_file": "evidence/NUMERIC_READBACK.json",
      "source_line": 16,
      "evidence": "GLU_CONTROL combines one double-precision replica (mean C-alpha distance 10.2110 A) with two mixed-precision replicas (12.5252 A and 11.9192 A), whereas GLU_LINKED uses three mixed-precision replicas; additionally, candidate_pilot.py line 124 adds HBonds constraints to GLU solute X-H pairs without removing their HarmonicBondForce entries from line 26.",
      "implication": "The single double-precision trajectory in GLU_CONTROL is a low-distance outlier (10.211 A vs 12.525 A and 11.919 A), inflating the reported GLU_CONTROL replica SD (1.2000 A) and shifting the group mean in the small n = 3 sample.",
      "recommended_check": "Re-run GLU_CONTROL replica 0 in mixed precision (or run all replicas in uniform double precision) and omit constrained X-H pairs from HarmonicBondForce when constructing the wet Amber System.",
      "claim_status": "simulation_result"
    }
  ],
  "strongest_surviving_claim": "The split-residue glucosepane topology (AGS:NZ-LGX:CE) and its unlinked Arg/Lys control are numerically self-consistent in OpenMM, reproducing the GROMACS Amber99SB*-ILDNP topology parser to ~10^-14 kJ/mol/atom in dry energy and ~10^-13 kJ/mol/nm in forces, and completing twelve 50-ps explicit-solvent trajectories without constraint violations or relative tetrahedral sign inversions.",
  "decisive_next_experiment": "Before longer MD, run a 4-arm controlled glucosepane validation in a triple-helical collagen model peptide (or end-tethered two-chain excerpt) under uniform integration precision with explicit-solvent-first side-chain equilibration: (1) Priority 1 — verify absolute CIP (R/S) stereochemistry of the 3 AGS ring chiral centers against canonical D-glucose-derived glucosepane; (2) Priority 2 — compare four chemical states: (a) neutral glucosepane (AGS+LGX = 0 e), (b) physiological protonated glucosepane (AGS+LGX = +1 e), (c) canonical charged unlinked control (ARG+1 / LYS+1), and (d) charge-matched neutral unlinked control (deprotonated ARG0 / LYN0) with weak terminal C-alpha positional restraints (k = 10 kJ/mol/nm^2 on terminal residues only) across n >= 5 independent solvent/velocity seeds ( >= 5 ns per replica); (3) Recorded observables — inter-chain modified C-alpha distance distribution, AGS/LGX ring puckering and torsion distributions, radial distribution of Na+/Cl- and water around the imidazoazepine ring, and block-averaged standard errors; (4) Convergence/stop criteria — block-averaged C-alpha distance SEM < 0.15 A and split-half ring torsion JSD < 0.05; (5) Falsifier — if the C-alpha distance shift between canonical unlinked (ARG+1/LYS+1) and charge-matched neutral unlinked (ARG0/LYN0) exceeds 50% of the difference between GLU_CONTROL and GLU_LINKED, the pilot C-alpha difference is dominated by local electrostatic repulsion and strand untethering rather than covalent crosslink mechanics.",
  "literature_to_verify": [
    {
      "query": "Giannetti et al. PMC13348703 AGEs-ColBuilder glucosepane AGS LGX protonation state RESP charge derivation and ring stereochemistry",
      "reason": "Verify why the published ColBuilder AGS and LGX RTP entries sum to neutral charge (-1e-6 e) instead of +1 e and confirm which diastereomer of glucosepane was parameterized.",
      "verification_status": "unverified"
    },
    {
      "query": "Glucosepane 6-amino-7,8-dihydro-5H-imidazo[4,5-b]azepine experimental pKa NMR stereochemistry and physiological protonation state at pH 7.4",
      "reason": "Confirm the experimental pKa of the bicyclic guanidinium core of glucosepane and the canonical configurations of its three ring stereocenters derived from D-glucose.",
      "verification_status": "unverified"
    }
  ]
}
